nett_share_of_ww.provenance: fitted: lifetime India nett ÷ worldwide gross, Hindi set 2016–2025

india_share_of_ww_south.provenance: fitted on the few Wikipedia rows printing both India and worldwide gross; implied_nett_share divides by the 1.22 gross→nett ratio established on the Hindi set. Thin data (n=23 across four industries) — treat as a prior, not a constant

scale_ww_cr.provenance: from Wikipedia highest-grossing lists per language (worldwide gross, conservative estimates); these lists are top-of-market, so the median is the median of NOTABLE films, not of all releases

ww_gross_over_budget.provenance: fitted where both figures exist; budgets are the least reliable field everywhere (±30%)

korea.provenance: fitted from Wikipedia Korean box-office tables (admissions and US$ gross where both printed)

japan.provenance: fitted from Wikipedia Japanese year tables (¥bn distributor gross)

global.provenance: Wikipedia highest-grossing films per year 2016–2025, top 10 each

south_verdict_words.provenance: keyword read of Wikipedia lead sentences — indicative only, never used as a fitted target
